verdict.rationale: AFK's core is a built-in AI you delegate work to. You set a goal like "Get to $1m ARR" and the AI breaks it into tasks, carries the process forward, and asks only when it needs a human decision. It also pre-fills forms from known company context and runs operational tasks "on autopilot" with sign-off on writes. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation beyond landing-page marketing claims, independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as described.
